The storm , for instance , in Herodotus is , as far as the ideas go , wonderfully described , but it includes certain things which are , Heaven knows , beneath the dignity of the subject . One might instance perhaps " the sea seething " : the word " seething " is so cacophonous that it takes off a great deal of the sublimity .
It will be foul weather to - day : for the heaven is red and lowering .

it was winter ;
And when neither sun nor stars shone upon us for many days , and no small tempest lay on us , all hope that we should be saved was now taken away .
Give diligence to come before winter .

For just as pilots for their voyages , before sailing from the harbour , fit their ship out with everything that a ship requires ; yet when a storm blows up they do , not what they wish , but what they must , boldly staking their fortunes against the driving peril of chance and calling to their aid no memory of their past practice but assistance appropriate to the existing circumstances ;

just so generals will prepare their armies as they believe will be best , but when the storm of war is at hand repeatedly shattering , overthrowing , and bringing varied conditions , the sight of present circumstances demands expedients based on the exigencies of the moment , which the necessity of chance rather than the memory of experience suggests .

For as the ark of Noah , bearing the world in the world - filling flood , bore up against the waves , so you , the guardian of the law , when surrounded on every side by the flood of passions , and straitened by violent storms which were the torments of they children , did bear up nobly against the storms against religion .
